Game Overview

Alex Meets Ally Spring is a platformer title where guide Alex through intriguing platformer levels filled with monsters and mind-bending puzzles. Race against time to collect stars, unlocking Ally's cage. Strategically deploy bombs, utilize lifts, and press buttons to navigate this delightfully addictive adventure. Can you reunite the friends before time runs out?
